AVAILABLE AGENTS (with input/output contracts):
  - office-climate-sensor (dynamic): Publishes office temperature and humidity every 60s
    capabilities: temperature, humidity, office, climate
    publishes: ['custom/office/climate']
    topic 'custom/office/climate' payload fields: {'temp': 'float', 'hum': 'float'}  example: {'temp': 24.6, 'hum': 41}
  - discord-notifier (dynamic): Sends a message to a Discord webhook
    capabilities: discord, notify, message, alert
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - telegram-notifier (dynamic): Sends a Telegram message to the configured chat
    capabilities: telegram, notify, message
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - camera-person-detector (dynamic): Runs person detection on the pc camera and publishes detections
    capabilities: camera, vision, person, detection
    publishes: ['custom/camera/detections']
    topic 'custom/camera/detections' payload fields: {'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example: {'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}
  - energy-monitor (dynamic): Publishes current household power draw
    capabilities: energy, power, consumption
    publishes: ['custom/home/energy']
    topic 'custom/home/energy' payload fields: {'watts': 'int'}  example: {'watts': 812}
  - weather-agent (dynamic): Fetches current weather for a city from wttr.in
    capabilities: weather, forecast, temperature, outdoor
    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers
    capabilities: presence, occupancy, home, away
    publishes: ['custom/home/presence']
    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}
  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state
    capabilities: battery, phone, charge
    publishes: ['custom/phone/battery']
    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
  - anomaly-detector (dynamic): Flags outliers in any numeric MQTT stream
    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

LIVE TOPIC SCHEMAS (use EXACTLY these field names in generated code):
  custom/office/climate (by office-climate-sensor): fields={'temp': 'float', 'hum': 'float'}  example={'temp': 24.6, 'hum': 41}
  custom/camera/detections (by camera-person-detector): fields={'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example={'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}
  custom/home/energy (by energy-monitor): fields={'watts': 'int'}  example={'watts': 812}
  custom/home/presence (by presence-tracker): fields={'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example={'home': False, 'who': ''}
  custom/phone/battery (by battery-watch): fields={'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example={'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
CRITICAL: Use the exact field names from the samples above. If a sample shows 'temp', use payload['temp'] — NOT payload['temperature'].

AVAILABLE AGENTS (with input/output contracts):
  - office-climate-sensor (dynamic): Publishes office temperature and humidity every 60s
    capabilities: temperature, humidity, office, climate
    publishes: ['custom/office/climate']
    topic 'custom/office/climate' payload fields: {'temp': 'float', 'hum': 'float'}  example: {'temp': 24.6, 'hum': 41}
  - discord-notifier (dynamic): Sends a message to a Discord webhook
    capabilities: discord, notify, message, alert
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - telegram-notifier (dynamic): Sends a Telegram message to the configured chat
    capabilities: telegram, notify, message
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - camera-person-detector (dynamic): Runs person detection on the pc camera and publishes detections
    capabilities: camera, vision, person, detection
    publishes: ['custom/camera/detections']
    topic 'custom/camera/detections' payload fields: {'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example: {'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}
  - energy-monitor (dynamic): Publishes current household power draw
    capabilities: energy, power, consumption
    publishes: ['custom/home/energy']
    topic 'custom/home/energy' payload fields: {'watts': 'int'}  example: {'watts': 812}
  - weather-agent (dynamic): Fetches current weather for a city from wttr.in
    capabilities: weather, forecast, temperature, outdoor
    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers
    capabilities: presence, occupancy, home, away
    publishes: ['custom/home/presence']
    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}
  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state
    capabilities: battery, phone, charge
    publishes: ['custom/phone/battery']
    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
  - anomaly-detector (dynamic): Flags outliers in any numeric MQTT stream
    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

AVAILABLE AGENTS (with input/output contracts):
  - office-climate-sensor (dynamic): Publishes office temperature and humidity every 60s
    capabilities: temperature, humidity, office, climate
    publishes: ['custom/office/climate']
    topic 'custom/office/climate' payload fields: {'temp': 'float', 'hum': 'float'}  example: {'temp': 24.6, 'hum': 41}
  - discord-notifier (dynamic): Sends a message to a Discord webhook
    capabilities: discord, notify, message, alert
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - telegram-notifier (dynamic): Sends a Telegram message to the configured chat
    capabilities: telegram, notify, message
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - camera-person-detector (dynamic): Runs person detection on the pc camera and publishes detections
    capabilities: camera, vision, person, detection
    publishes: ['custom/camera/detections']
    topic 'custom/camera/detections' payload fields: {'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example: {'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}
  - energy-monitor (dynamic): Publishes current household power draw
    capabilities: energy, power, consumption
    publishes: ['custom/home/energy']
    topic 'custom/home/energy' payload fields: {'watts': 'int'}  example: {'watts': 812}
  - weather-agent (dynamic): Fetches current weather for a city from wttr.in
    capabilities: weather, forecast, temperature, outdoor
    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers
    capabilities: presence, occupancy, home, away
    publishes: ['custom/home/presence']
    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}
  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state
    capabilities: battery, phone, charge
    publishes: ['custom/phone/battery']
    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
  - anomaly-detector (dynamic): Flags outliers in any numeric MQTT stream
    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

AVAILABLE AGENTS (with input/output contracts):
  - office-climate-sensor (dynamic): Publishes office temperature and humidity every 60s
    capabilities: temperature, humidity, office, climate
    publishes: ['custom/office/climate']
    topic 'custom/office/climate' payload fields: {'temp': 'float', 'hum': 'float'}  example: {'temp': 24.6, 'hum': 41}
  - discord-notifier (dynamic): Sends a message to a Discord webhook
    capabilities: discord, notify, message, alert
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - telegram-notifier (dynamic): Sends a Telegram message to the configured chat
    capabilities: telegram, notify, message
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - camera-person-detector (dynamic): Runs person detection on the pc camera and publishes detections
    capabilities: camera, vision, person, detection
    publishes: ['custom/camera/detections']
    topic 'custom/camera/detections' payload fields: {'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example: {'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}
  - energy-monitor (dynamic): Publishes current household power draw
    capabilities: energy, power, consumption
    publishes: ['custom/home/energy']
    topic 'custom/home/energy' payload fields: {'watts': 'int'}  example: {'watts': 812}
  - weather-agent (dynamic): Fetches current weather for a city from wttr.in
    capabilities: weather, forecast, temperature, outdoor
    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers
    capabilities: presence, occupancy, home, away
    publishes: ['custom/home/presence']
    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}
  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state
    capabilities: battery, phone, charge
    publishes: ['custom/phone/battery']
    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
  - anomaly-detector (dynamic): Flags outliers in any numeric MQTT stream
    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

AVAILABLE AGENTS (with input/output contracts):
  - office-climate-sensor (dynamic): Publishes office temperature and humidity every 60s
    capabilities: temperature, humidity, office, climate
    publishes: ['custom/office/climate']
    topic 'custom/office/climate' payload fields: {'temp': 'float', 'hum': 'float'}  example: {'temp': 24.6, 'hum': 41}
  - discord-notifier (dynamic): Sends a message to a Discord webhook
    capabilities: discord, notify, message, alert
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - telegram-notifier (dynamic): Sends a Telegram message to the configured chat
    capabilities: telegram, notify, message
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - camera-person-detector (dynamic): Runs person detection on the pc camera and publishes detections
    capabilities: camera, vision, person, detection
    publishes: ['custom/camera/detections']
    topic 'custom/camera/detections' payload fields: {'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example: {'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}
  - energy-monitor (dynamic): Publishes current household power draw
    capabilities: energy, power, consumption
    publishes: ['custom/home/energy']
    topic 'custom/home/energy' payload fields: {'watts': 'int'}  example: {'watts': 812}
  - weather-agent (dynamic): Fetches current weather for a city from wttr.in
    capabilities: weather, forecast, temperature, outdoor
    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers
    capabilities: presence, occupancy, home, away
    publishes: ['custom/home/presence']
    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}
  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state
    capabilities: battery, phone, charge
    publishes: ['custom/phone/battery']
    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
  - anomaly-detector (dynamic): Flags outliers in any numeric MQTT stream
    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

AVAILABLE AGENTS (with input/output contracts):
  - office-climate-sensor (dynamic): Publishes office temperature and humidity every 60s
    capabilities: temperature, humidity, office, climate
    publishes: ['custom/office/climate']
    topic 'custom/office/climate' payload fields: {'temp': 'float', 'hum': 'float'}  example: {'temp': 24.6, 'hum': 41}
  - discord-notifier (dynamic): Sends a message to a Discord webhook
    capabilities: discord, notify, message, alert
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - telegram-notifier (dynamic): Sends a Telegram message to the configured chat
    capabilities: telegram, notify, message
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - camera-person-detector (dynamic): Runs person detection on the pc camera and publishes detections
    capabilities: camera, vision, person, detection
    publishes: ['custom/camera/detections']
    topic 'custom/camera/detections' payload fields: {'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example: {'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}
  - energy-monitor (dynamic): Publishes current household power draw
    capabilities: energy, power, consumption
    publishes: ['custom/home/energy']
    topic 'custom/home/energy' payload fields: {'watts': 'int'}  example: {'watts': 812}
  - weather-agent (dynamic): Fetches current weather for a city from wttr.in
    capabilities: weather, forecast, temperature, outdoor
    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers
    capabilities: presence, occupancy, home, away
    publishes: ['custom/home/presence']
    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}
  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state
    capabilities: battery, phone, charge
    publishes: ['custom/phone/battery']
    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
  - anomaly-detector (dynamic): Flags outliers in any numeric MQTT stream
    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

AVAILABLE AGENTS (with input/output contracts):
  - office-climate-sensor (dynamic): Publishes office temperature and humidity every 60s
    capabilities: temperature, humidity, office, climate
    publishes: ['custom/office/climate']
    topic 'custom/office/climate' payload fields: {'temp': 'float', 'hum': 'float'}  example: {'temp': 24.6, 'hum': 41}
  - discord-notifier (dynamic): Sends a message to a Discord webhook
    capabilities: discord, notify, message, alert
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - telegram-notifier (dynamic): Sends a Telegram message to the configured chat
    capabilities: telegram, notify, message
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - camera-person-detector (dynamic): Runs person detection on the pc camera and publishes detections
    capabilities: camera, vision, person, detection
    publishes: ['custom/camera/detections']
    topic 'custom/camera/detections' payload fields: {'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example: {'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}
  - energy-monitor (dynamic): Publishes current household power draw
    capabilities: energy, power, consumption
    publishes: ['custom/home/energy']
    topic 'custom/home/energy' payload fields: {'watts': 'int'}  example: {'watts': 812}
  - weather-agent (dynamic): Fetches current weather for a city from wttr.in
    capabilities: weather, forecast, temperature, outdoor
    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers
    capabilities: presence, occupancy, home, away
    publishes: ['custom/home/presence']
    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}
  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state
    capabilities: battery, phone, charge
    publishes: ['custom/phone/battery']
    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
  - anomaly-detector (dynamic): Flags outliers in any numeric MQTT stream
    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

AVAILABLE AGENTS (with input/output contracts):
  - office-climate-sensor (dynamic): Publishes office temperature and humidity every 60s
    capabilities: temperature, humidity, office, climate
    publishes: ['custom/office/climate']
    topic 'custom/office/climate' payload fields: {'temp': 'float', 'hum': 'float'}  example: {'temp': 24.6, 'hum': 41}
  - discord-notifier (dynamic): Sends a message to a Discord webhook
    capabilities: discord, notify, message, alert
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - telegram-notifier (dynamic): Sends a Telegram message to the configured chat
    capabilities: telegram, notify, message
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - camera-person-detector (dynamic): Runs person detection on the pc camera and publishes detections
    capabilities: camera, vision, person, detection
    publishes: ['custom/camera/detections']
    topic 'custom/camera/detections' payload fields: {'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example: {'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}
  - energy-monitor (dynamic): Publishes current household power draw
    capabilities: energy, power, consumption
    publishes: ['custom/home/energy']
    topic 'custom/home/energy' payload fields: {'watts': 'int'}  example: {'watts': 812}
  - weather-agent (dynamic): Fetches current weather for a city from wttr.in
    capabilities: weather, forecast, temperature, outdoor
    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers
    capabilities: presence, occupancy, home, away
    publishes: ['custom/home/presence']
    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}
  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state
    capabilities: battery, phone, charge
    publishes: ['custom/phone/battery']
    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
  - anomaly-detector (dynamic): Flags outliers in any numeric MQTT stream
    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

AVAILABLE AGENTS (with input/output contracts):
  - office-climate-sensor (dynamic): Publishes office temperature and humidity every 60s
    capabilities: temperature, humidity, office, climate
    publishes: ['custom/office/climate']
    topic 'custom/office/climate' payload fields: {'temp': 'float', 'hum': 'float'}  example: {'temp': 24.6, 'hum': 41}
  - discord-notifier (dynamic): Sends a message to a Discord webhook
    capabilities: discord, notify, message, alert
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - telegram-notifier (dynamic): Sends a Telegram message to the configured chat
    capabilities: telegram, notify, message
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - camera-person-detector (dynamic): Runs person detection on the pc camera and publishes detections
    capabilities: camera, vision, person, detection
    publishes: ['custom/camera/detections']
    topic 'custom/camera/detections' payload fields: {'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example: {'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}
  - energy-monitor (dynamic): Publishes current household power draw
    capabilities: energy, power, consumption
    publishes: ['custom/home/energy']
    topic 'custom/home/energy' payload fields: {'watts': 'int'}  example: {'watts': 812}
  - weather-agent (dynamic): Fetches current weather for a city from wttr.in
    capabilities: weather, forecast, temperature, outdoor
    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers
    capabilities: presence, occupancy, home, away
    publishes: ['custom/home/presence']
    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}
  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state
    capabilities: battery, phone, charge
    publishes: ['custom/phone/battery']
    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
  - anomaly-detector (dynamic): Flags outliers in any numeric MQTT stream
    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

AVAILABLE AGENTS (with input/output contracts):
  - office-climate-sensor (dynamic): Publishes office temperature and humidity every 60s
    capabilities: temperature, humidity, office, climate
    publishes: ['custom/office/climate']
    topic 'custom/office/climate' payload fields: {'temp': 'float', 'hum': 'float'}  example: {'temp': 24.6, 'hum': 41}
  - discord-notifier (dynamic): Sends a message to a Discord webhook
    capabilities: discord, notify, message, alert
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - telegram-notifier (dynamic): Sends a Telegram message to the configured chat
    capabilities: telegram, notify, message
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - camera-person-detector (dynamic): Runs person detection on the pc camera and publishes detections
    capabilities: camera, vision, person, detection
    publishes: ['custom/camera/detections']
    topic 'custom/camera/detections' payload fields: {'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example: {'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}
  - energy-monitor (dynamic): Publishes current household power draw
    capabilities: energy, power, consumption
    publishes: ['custom/home/energy']
    topic 'custom/home/energy' payload fields: {'watts': 'int'}  example: {'watts': 812}
  - weather-agent (dynamic): Fetches current weather for a city from wttr.in
    capabilities: weather, forecast, temperature, outdoor
    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers
    capabilities: presence, occupancy, home, away
    publishes: ['custom/home/presence']
    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}
  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state
    capabilities: battery, phone, charge
    publishes: ['custom/phone/battery']
    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
  - anomaly-detector (dynamic): Flags outliers in any numeric MQTT stream
    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}

    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - telegram-notifier (dynamic): Sends a Telegram message to the configured chat
    capabilities: telegram, notify, message
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - camera-person-detector (dynamic): Runs person detection on the pc camera and publishes detections
    capabilities: camera, vision, person, detection
    publishes: ['custom/camera/detections']
    topic 'custom/camera/detections' payload fields: {'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example: {'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}

    capabilities: energy, power, consumption
    publishes: ['custom/home/energy']
    topic 'custom/home/energy' payload fields: {'watts': 'int'}  example: {'watts': 812}
  - weather-agent (dynamic): Fetches current weather for a city from wttr.in
    capabilities: weather, forecast, temperature, outdoor
    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers
    capabilities: presence, occupancy, home, away
    publishes: ['custom/home/presence']
    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}
  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state
    capabilities: battery, phone, charge
    publishes: ['custom/phone/battery']
    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
  - anomaly-detector (dynamic): Flags outliers in any numeric MQTT stream
    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

  - office-climate-sensor (dynamic): Publishes office temperature and humidity every 60s

    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - telegram-notifier (dynamic): Sends a Telegram message to the configured chat
    capabilities: telegram, notify, message
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - camera-person-detector (dynamic): Runs person detection on the pc camera and publishes detections
    capabilities: camera, vision, person, detection
    publishes: ['custom/camera/detections']
    topic 'custom/camera/detections' payload fields: {'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example: {'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}
  - energy-monitor (dynamic): Publishes current household power draw
    capabilities: energy, power, consumption
    publishes: ['custom/home/energy']
    topic 'custom/home/energy' payload fields: {'watts': 'int'}  example: {'watts': 812}
  - weather-agent (dynamic): Fetches current weather for a city from wttr.in
    capabilities: weather, forecast, temperature, outdoor
    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers
    capabilities: presence, occupancy, home, away
    publishes: ['custom/home/presence']
    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}
  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state
    capabilities: battery, phone, charge
    publishes: ['custom/phone/battery']
    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
  - anomaly-detector (dynamic): Flags outliers in any numeric MQTT stream
    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

  - office-climate-sensor (dynamic): Publishes office temperature and humidity every 60s
    capabilities: temperature, humidity, office, climate
    publishes: ['custom/office/climate']
    topic 'custom/office/climate' payload fields: {'temp': 'float', 'hum': 'float'}  example: {'temp': 24.6, 'hum': 41}
  - discord-notifier (dynamic): Sends a message to a Discord webhook
    capabilities: discord, notify, message, alert
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - telegram-notifier (dynamic): Sends a Telegram message to the configured chat
    capabilities: telegram, notify, message
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - camera-person-detector (dynamic): Runs person detection on the pc camera and publishes detections
    capabilities: camera, vision, person, detection
    publishes: ['custom/camera/detections']
    topic 'custom/camera/detections' payload fields: {'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example: {'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}
  - energy-monitor (dynamic): Publishes current household power draw
    capabilities: energy, power, consumption
    publishes: ['custom/home/energy']
    topic 'custom/home/energy' payload fields: {'watts': 'int'}  example: {'watts': 812}
  - weather-agent (dynamic): Fetches current weather for a city from wttr.in
    capabilities: weather, forecast, temperature, outdoor
    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers
    capabilities: presence, occupancy, home, away
    publishes: ['custom/home/presence']
    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}
  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state
    capabilities: battery, phone, charge
    publishes: ['custom/phone/battery']
    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
  - anomaly-detector (dynamic): Flags outliers in any numeric MQTT stream
    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

AVAILABLE AGENTS (with input/output contracts):
  - office-climate-sensor (dynamic): Publishes office temperature and humidity every 60s
    capabilities: temperature, humidity, office, climate
    publishes: ['custom/office/climate']
    topic 'custom/office/climate' payload fields: {'temp': 'float', 'hum': 'float'}  example: {'temp': 24.6, 'hum': 41}
  - discord-notifier (dynamic): Sends a message to a Discord webhook
    capabilities: discord, notify, message, alert
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - telegram-notifier (dynamic): Sends a Telegram message to the configured chat
    capabilities: telegram, notify, message
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - camera-person-detector (dynamic): Runs person detection on the pc camera and publishes detections
    capabilities: camera, vision, person, detection
    publishes: ['custom/camera/detections']
    topic 'custom/camera/detections' payload fields: {'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example: {'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}
  - energy-monitor (dynamic): Publishes current household power draw
    capabilities: energy, power, consumption
    publishes: ['custom/home/energy']
    topic 'custom/home/energy' payload fields: {'watts': 'int'}  example: {'watts': 812}
  - weather-agent (dynamic): Fetches current weather for a city from wttr.in
    capabilities: weather, forecast, temperature, outdoor
    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers
    capabilities: presence, occupancy, home, away
    publishes: ['custom/home/presence']
    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}
  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state
    capabilities: battery, phone, charge
    publishes: ['custom/phone/battery']
    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
  - anomaly-detector (dynamic): Flags outliers in any numeric MQTT stream
    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

AVAILABLE AGENTS (with input/output contracts):
  - office-climate-sensor (dynamic): Publishes office temperature and humidity every 60s
    capabilities: temperature, humidity, office, climate
    publishes: ['custom/office/climate']
    topic 'custom/office/climate' payload fields: {'temp': 'float', 'hum': 'float'}  example: {'temp': 24.6, 'hum': 41}
  - discord-notifier (dynamic): Sends a message to a Discord webhook
    capabilities: discord, notify, message, alert
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - telegram-notifier (dynamic): Sends a Telegram message to the configured chat
    capabilities: telegram, notify, message
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - camera-person-detector (dynamic): Runs person detection on the pc camera and publishes detections
    capabilities: camera, vision, person, detection
    publishes: ['custom/camera/detections']
    topic 'custom/camera/detections' payload fields: {'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example: {'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}
  - energy-monitor (dynamic): Publishes current household power draw
    capabilities: energy, power, consumption
    publishes: ['custom/home/energy']
    topic 'custom/home/energy' payload fields: {'watts': 'int'}  example: {'watts': 812}
  - weather-agent (dynamic): Fetches current weather for a city from wttr.in
    capabilities: weather, forecast, temperature, outdoor
    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers
    capabilities: presence, occupancy, home, away
    publishes: ['custom/home/presence']
    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}
  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state
    capabilities: battery, phone, charge
    publishes: ['custom/phone/battery']
    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
  - anomaly-detector (dynamic): Flags outliers in any numeric MQTT stream
    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

  - office-climate-sensor (dynamic): Publishes office temperature and humidity every 60s

  - discord-notifier (dynamic): Sends a message to a Discord webhook
    capabilities: discord, notify, message, alert
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - telegram-notifier (dynamic): Sends a Telegram message to the configured chat
    capabilities: telegram, notify, message
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - camera-person-detector (dynamic): Runs person detection on the pc camera and publishes detections
    capabilities: camera, vision, person, detection
    publishes: ['custom/camera/detections']
    topic 'custom/camera/detections' payload fields: {'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example: {'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}
  - energy-monitor (dynamic): Publishes current household power draw
    capabilities: energy, power, consumption
    publishes: ['custom/home/energy']
    topic 'custom/home/energy' payload fields: {'watts': 'int'}  example: {'watts': 812}
  - weather-agent (dynamic): Fetches current weather for a city from wttr.in
    capabilities: weather, forecast, temperature, outdoor
    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers
    capabilities: presence, occupancy, home, away
    publishes: ['custom/home/presence']
    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}
  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state
    capabilities: battery, phone, charge
    publishes: ['custom/phone/battery']
    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
  - anomaly-detector (dynamic): Flags outliers in any numeric MQTT stream
    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

AVAILABLE AGENTS (with input/output contracts):
  - office-climate-sensor (dynamic): Publishes office temperature and humidity every 60s
    capabilities: temperature, humidity, office, climate
    publishes: ['custom/office/climate']
    topic 'custom/office/climate' payload fields: {'temp': 'float', 'hum': 'float'}  example: {'temp': 24.6, 'hum': 41}
  - discord-notifier (dynamic): Sends a message to a Discord webhook
    capabilities: discord, notify, message, alert
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - telegram-notifier (dynamic): Sends a Telegram message to the configured chat
    capabilities: telegram, notify, message
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - camera-person-detector (dynamic): Runs person detection on the pc camera and publishes detections
    capabilities: camera, vision, person, detection
    publishes: ['custom/camera/detections']
    topic 'custom/camera/detections' payload fields: {'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example: {'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}
  - energy-monitor (dynamic): Publishes current household power draw
    capabilities: energy, power, consumption
    publishes: ['custom/home/energy']
    topic 'custom/home/energy' payload fields: {'watts': 'int'}  example: {'watts': 812}
  - weather-agent (dynamic): Fetches current weather for a city from wttr.in
    capabilities: weather, forecast, temperature, outdoor
    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers
    capabilities: presence, occupancy, home, away
    publishes: ['custom/home/presence']
    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}
  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state
    capabilities: battery, phone, charge
    publishes: ['custom/phone/battery']
    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
  - anomaly-detector (dynamic): Flags outliers in any numeric MQTT stream
    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}

    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}

    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}

AVAILABLE AGENTS (with input/output contracts):
  - office-climate-sensor (dynamic): Publishes office temperature and humidity every 60s
    capabilities: temperature, humidity, office, climate
    publishes: ['custom/office/climate']
    topic 'custom/office/climate' payload fields: {'temp': 'float', 'hum': 'float'}  example: {'temp': 24.6, 'hum': 41}
  - discord-notifier (dynamic): Sends a message to a Discord webhook
    capabilities: discord, notify, message, alert
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - telegram-notifier (dynamic): Sends a Telegram message to the configured chat
    capabilities: telegram, notify, message
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - camera-person-detector (dynamic): Runs person detection on the pc camera and publishes detections
    capabilities: camera, vision, person, detection
    publishes: ['custom/camera/detections']
    topic 'custom/camera/detections' payload fields: {'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example: {'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}
  - energy-monitor (dynamic): Publishes current household power draw
    capabilities: energy, power, consumption
    publishes: ['custom/home/energy']
    topic 'custom/home/energy' payload fields: {'watts': 'int'}  example: {'watts': 812}
  - weather-agent (dynamic): Fetches current weather for a city from wttr.in
    capabilities: weather, forecast, temperature, outdoor
    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers
    capabilities: presence, occupancy, home, away
    publishes: ['custom/home/presence']
    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}
  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state
    capabilities: battery, phone, charge
    publishes: ['custom/phone/battery']
    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
  - anomaly-detector (dynamic): Flags outliers in any numeric MQTT stream
    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state

    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}

    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers

  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them

    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

AVAILABLE AGENTS (with input/output contracts):
  - office-climate-sensor (dynamic): Publishes office temperature and humidity every 60s
    capabilities: temperature, humidity, office, climate
    publishes: ['custom/office/climate']
    topic 'custom/office/climate' payload fields: {'temp': 'float', 'hum': 'float'}  example: {'temp': 24.6, 'hum': 41}
  - discord-notifier (dynamic): Sends a message to a Discord webhook
    capabilities: discord, notify, message, alert
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - telegram-notifier (dynamic): Sends a Telegram message to the configured chat
    capabilities: telegram, notify, message
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - camera-person-detector (dynamic): Runs person detection on the pc camera and publishes detections
    capabilities: camera, vision, person, detection
    publishes: ['custom/camera/detections']
    topic 'custom/camera/detections' payload fields: {'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example: {'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}
  - energy-monitor (dynamic): Publishes current household power draw
    capabilities: energy, power, consumption
    publishes: ['custom/home/energy']
    topic 'custom/home/energy' payload fields: {'watts': 'int'}  example: {'watts': 812}
  - weather-agent (dynamic): Fetches current weather for a city from wttr.in
    capabilities: weather, forecast, temperature, outdoor
    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers
    capabilities: presence, occupancy, home, away
    publishes: ['custom/home/presence']
    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}
  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state
    capabilities: battery, phone, charge
    publishes: ['custom/phone/battery']
    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
  - anomaly-detector (dynamic): Flags outliers in any numeric MQTT stream
    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}

  - office-climate-sensor (dynamic): Publishes office temperature and humidity every 60s

    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - telegram-notifier (dynamic): Sends a Telegram message to the configured chat
    capabilities: telegram, notify, message
    input_schema : {'text': 'str — message body'}
    output_schema: {'ok': 'bool'}
  - camera-person-detector (dynamic): Runs person detection on the pc camera and publishes detections
    capabilities: camera, vision, person, detection
    publishes: ['custom/camera/detections']
    topic 'custom/camera/detections' payload fields: {'person': 'bool', 'conf': 'float'}  example: {'person': True, 'conf': 0.91}
  - energy-monitor (dynamic): Publishes current household power draw
    capabilities: energy, power, consumption
    publishes: ['custom/home/energy']
    topic 'custom/home/energy' payload fields: {'watts': 'int'}  example: {'watts': 812}
  - weather-agent (dynamic): Fetches current weather for a city from wttr.in
    capabilities: weather, forecast, temperature, outdoor
    input_schema : {'city': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'temp_c': 'float', 'condition': 'str'}
  - presence-tracker (dynamic): Tracks whether anyone is home from phone device trackers
    capabilities: presence, occupancy, home, away
    publishes: ['custom/home/presence']
    topic 'custom/home/presence' payload fields: {'home': 'bool', 'who': 'str'}  example: {'home': False, 'who': ''}
  - battery-watch (dynamic): Publishes phone battery level and charging state
    capabilities: battery, phone, charge
    publishes: ['custom/phone/battery']
    topic 'custom/phone/battery' payload fields: {'pct': 'int', 'charging': 'bool'}  example: {'pct': 63, 'charging': False}
  - anomaly-detector (dynamic): Flags outliers in any numeric MQTT stream
    capabilities: anomaly, outlier, statistics
    input_schema : {'topic': 'str', 'field': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'anomaly': 'bool', 'score': 'float'}
  - manual-agent (dynamic): Finds device manuals online and answers questions from them
    capabilities: manuals, pdf, device_docs
    input_schema : {'text': 'str'}
    output_schema: {'result': 'str'}
